newsitem.title: USA: Chile's Aninat confident of '96 6.5 inflation - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Aninat confident of '96 6.5 inflation - RFTV.

text.p: Chile's Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat said Wednesday that he felt confident about government inflation targets of 6.5 percent in 1996 and 5.5 percent next year.
"At this stage I am most confident that we will be at the 6.5 percent (inflation) mark for the year," Aninat told Reuters Financial television. "We do not see cost pressures."
Aninat also said he did not think lower interest rates would be appropriate this year, but might be apporpriate "sometime next year."
